_about: Hand content of Appendix E (the formula sheet) that the chapters do not hold, applied by make_app_E.py.
Keys: '<chapter label>|<first equation label of the display>', or '<chapter label>|body:<display body, white space removed>' for a
display with no label ('#2', '#3' for a repeat within one chapter).
omit: displays left out of the sheet. body / status / intext: the sheet's text ('sheet') replaces what the chapter rule gives
('chapter'); if the chapter no longer gives 'chapter', make_app_E.py warns and uses the chapter, so a chapter change is never hidden.
desc: the one-line descriptions written for the earlier selection of the sheet. 'entry' is the sheet entry number when the override
was written (for reading only; it is not used). 'why' says what each override is.

ch:iams_law|eq:law.sheet: IAM's Law: the minimum cost of one classical bit, paid at the temperature of the nearest encoding surface (horizon temperature $T_H$).

ch:iams_law|eq:law_entangle.sheet: Decoherence: a system--environment product state evolves into an entangled sum over pointer states.

ch:iams_law|eq:epochcost.sheet: Cost per bit at the cosmic horizon at scale factor $a$, using the Gibbons--Hawking temperature.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_eta.sheet: The Bekenstein--Hawking coefficient as the ratio of the Euclidean period $2\pi$ to the $8\pi$ of the field equations.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_F2.sheet: Cai--Kim: the first law at the apparent horizon gives the second Friedmann equation.

ch:iams_law|eq:firstlaw.sheet: Horizon entropy completed by the record term, and the first law applied to it at the apparent horizon. $S_{\rm total}$ is defined here.

ch:iams_law|eq:Hm.sheet: Matter-sector expansion rate: the record term adds $\beta_mE(a)H_0^2$ to the rate that matter perturbations feel.

ch:iams_law|eq:rate.sheet: Assumed form of the rate of record production from structure formation.

ch:iams_law|eq:Sdot.sheet: Rate of change of the record entropy: records priced at $k_BT_H\ln2$ and stored per unit horizon area.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_action.sheet: Constrained action for the record term ($\phi=\ln E$, Lagrange multiplier $\lambda$); its metric variation returns Eq.~\eqref{eq:Hm}.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_winfo.sheet: Effective equation of state of the record term, with values at $a=0.5,1,2$.

ch:iams_law|eq:mu.sheet: Effective growth coupling of matter, $\mu(a)<1$; light keeps $\Sigma=1$.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_dphi.sheet: The record field is unperturbed in linear theory.

ch:iams_law|eq:law_mahaffey.sheet: The Mahaffey number: drive energy over the thermal quantum.

ch:virial_law|eq:vl_euler.sheet: Virial theorem for a potential homogeneous of degree $k$.

ch:virial_law|eq:vl_beta.sheet: The cosmological coupling from the virial half, with Planck 2018 $\Omega_m=0.3153$.

ch:virial_identity|eq:vi_virial.sheet: Virial theorem for $1/r$ binding ($k=-1$): the kinetic half.

ch:virial|eq:vc_firstlaw.sheet: Horizon first law with the record entropy added (as Eq.~\eqref{eq:firstlaw}).

ch:virial|eq:vc_beta.sheet: The cosmological coupling from the virial half, with Planck 2018 $\Omega_m=0.3153$.

ch:virial|eq:vc_E.sheet: The activation function in scale factor and redshift (as Eq.~\eqref{eq:Ea}).

ch:virial|part2:eq:mu_virial.sheet: Linear growth equation in the $\mu$--$\Sigma$ form used by the Level~1 chains, with the growth coupling $\mu(a)$.

ch:virial|eq:vc_h0.sheet: Matter-sector Hubble constant from the photon-sector value of the Level~2 chain.

ch:theory|eq:th:entangle.sheet: Decoherence: a system--environment product state evolves into an entangled sum over pointer states.

ch:theory|eq:th:dQ.sheet: Heat flux across a local Rindler horizon, written with the boost Killing vector.

ch:theory|eq:th:Tab.sheet: Clausius relation for every null vector forces $T_{ab}$ proportional to $R_{ab}$ up to a term in $g_{ab}$.

ch:theory|eq:th:einstein.sheet: The Einstein equations as an equation of state, with $G$ fixed by $\eta$.

ch:theory|eq:th:dAmin.sheet: Smallest horizon area that holds one unit of entropy $k_B$: $4\ell_P^2$, independent of surface gravity.

ch:theory|eq:th:Hdot.sheet: Cai--Kim: the first law at the apparent horizon gives the second Friedmann equation.

ch:theory|eq:th:friedmann.sheet: Matter-sector expansion rate $H_{\rm IAM}$: the rate in the friction term of matter perturbations; the background stays $\Lambda$CDM.

ch:theory|eq:Idot.sheet: Assumed rate of information production by structure formation (as Eq.~\eqref{eq:rate}).

ch:theory|eq:dSdt.sheet: Accumulation of record entropy on the horizon: Landauer factor $1/T_H$ and holographic factor $1/A_H$.

ch:theory|eq:th:beta.sheet: The coupling from the virial partition $\rho_{\rm info}(1)=\tfrac12\rho_m$.

ch:theory|eq:Sn.sheet: Matter-era scaling of the record entropy per $\ln a$ and per $a$.

ch:theory|part2:eq:Ea.sheet: The activation function, boxed result of the decoherence constraint with $E(1)=1$.

ch:theory|eq:th:firstlaw3.sheet: Horizon first law with the record entropy (the sector split enters through (\ref{app:fs:60})).

ch:theory|eq:HIAM.sheet: Matter-sector expansion rate $H_{\rm IAM}$: the rate in the friction term of matter perturbations; the background stays $\Lambda$CDM.

ch:theory|eq:th:mudef.sheet: Modified Poisson equations of the $\mu$--$\Sigma$ framework in Fourier space; GR is $\mu=\Sigma=1$.

ch:theory|eq:th:action.sheet: Constrained action for the record term in the variational form.

ch:theory|eq:th:growth.sheet: Growth equation of matter perturbations with friction from the matter-sector rate.

ch:theory|eq:th:hoop.sheet: Collapse criterion as holographic saturation: record entropy per area reaching $1/4\ell_P^2$ (met exactly at the Schwarzschild radius).

ch:entropicgravity|eq:eg_Hdot.sheet: Cai--Kim: the first law at the apparent horizon gives the second Friedmann equation.

ch:dual|part2:eq:mu.sheet: The standard modified-growth form: $\mu(a)$ multiplies $G$ in the growth equation, $\Sigma=1$ in the lensing potential.

ch:latetime|eq:lt_mu.sheet: The form of $\mu(a)$ tested in the Level~1 MGCAMB chains, with $\beta=\Omega_m/2$.

ch:latetime|eq:lt_poisson.sheet: Modified Poisson equations of the $\mu$--$\Sigma$ framework in Fourier space; GR is $\mu=\Sigma=1$.

ch:latetime|eq:lt_mgcamb.sheet: The DES parametrization implemented in MGCAMB; the runs set $\mu_0=-0.13495$, $\Sigma_0=0$.

ch:level2|eq:l2_friedmann.sheet: The $\Lambda$CDM background expansion rate used for photons and the background in the Level~2 code.

ch:level2|eq:l2_Hm.sheet: Matter-sector rate used by the CDM and baryon perturbations in the modified CAMB, with $\beta_m=0.15765$.

ch:level2|eq:l2_mu.sheet: Growth coupling if the change acted as $G_{\rm eff}=\mu G$; present value $1/(1+\beta_m)$.

ch:dsnote|eq:dsn_firstlaw.sheet: Horizon first law with the record entropy added (as Eq.~\eqref{eq:firstlaw}).

ch:dsvalidation|eq:dsv_Hm.sheet: Matter-sector expansion rate in density-parameter form, used against the supernova Hubble diagram.

ch:dsvalidation|eq:dsv_Omdil.sheet: Matter density fraction with the record term in the denominator; lower than in $\Lambda$CDM, which lowers growth.

ch:darkenergy|part2:eq:Hm.sheet: Matter-sector expansion rate; the photon sector keeps the $\Lambda$CDM rate.

ch:wzfuture|eq:wz_norip.sheet: No-Big-Rip condition: $w_{\rm info}$ rises with $a$ and $\rho_{\rm info}$ is bounded by $e\,\rho_{\rm info}(1)$.

ch:lambda|eq:base.sheet: The cosmological-constant expression with writing fraction $\Omega_b/\Omega_m$ and geometric factor $2/\pi$; $1.218$ times the measured ratio.

ch:lambda|eq:corr.sheet: The same expression with the de Sitter temperature factor $\sqrt{\Omega_\Lambda}$; $0.79\,\%$ above the measured value.

ch:lambda|eq:ident.sheet: Horizon identity: the ratio rewritten exactly in Planck units; the 123 orders are $(l_P/l_H)^2$.

ch:lambda|eq:rel.sheet: What Eq.~\eqref{eq:corr} asserts once the identity is divided out: a present-epoch relation between baryon fraction and dark-energy fraction.

ch:lambda_history|eq:lh_integral.sheet: The accumulation integral for $\Lambda(a)$ over cosmic history; as written it overshoots by $\sim10^{30}$.

ch:surveys|eq:sp_mu.sheet: Matter coupling $\mu(a)$ with $E(a)$, $\beta_m=\Omega_m/2$ and $\Sigma=1$, as used for survey forecasts.

ch:surveys|eq:sp_siren.sheet: Matter-sector Hubble rate read by standard sirens, $H_0^{\rm m}=H_0^\gamma\sqrt{1+\beta_m}=72.26$.

ch:lensdyn|eq:ld_ratio.sheet: Lensing-to-dynamical mass ratio of a cluster, $1/\mu(z)$, in the Level~1 form.

ch:threeway|eq:tw_R.sheet: Lensing-to-hydrostatic mass ratio $R(z)=1/\mu(z)$ for the three-estimator cluster test.

ch:satellites|eq:ms_ps.sheet: Press--Schechter change in halo abundance for a fractional change $\epsilon$ in $\sigma_M$.

ch:blackholes|body:S_{\\rmBH}=\\frac{k_B.sheet: Bekenstein--Hawking entropy, Hawking temperature and horizon area of a Schwarzschild black hole of mass $M$.

ch:blackholes|eq:bh_Tuniv.sheet: Temperature of any causal horizon from its surface gravity $\kappa$ (black hole, de Sitter, Unruh).

ch:blackholes|eq:bh_smarr.sheet: Horizon bits priced at Landauer's minimum: the total is half the rest energy (Smarr relation).

ch:blackholes|body:\\begin{aligned}\\fra.sheet: Kerr black hole: fraction of rest energy held as $T_{\rm BH}S_{\rm BH}$ versus spin $\chi$, with three values.

ch:blackholes|eq:bh_Mt.sheet: Mass loss by Hawking radiation and the evaporation time (black-body approximation).

ch:blackholes|body:M_{\\rmCMB}=\\frac{\\.sheet: Mass at which a black hole is in radiative balance with the CMB today.

ch:blackholes|eq:bh_hoop.sheet: At the Schwarzschild radius the entropy per area equals the holographic bound $k_B/4\ell_P^2$.

ch:quantumrecords|eq:qr_n72.sheet: The exponent required by $E(a)$, read from the horizon accounting (top-down).

ch:quantumrecords|eq:qr_mu.sheet: Growth coupling $\mu(a)<1$ for matter and $\Sigma=1$ for light.

ch:quantumrecords|eq:qr_tauIAM.sheet: IAM gravitational decoherence time of a massive superposition, with the boundary capacity taken as $k_BT/E_G$; compared with Penrose--Di\'osi.

ch:entanglement|eq:ent:smax.sheet: Largest CHSH value of a pair dephasing in its pointer basis, as a function of the coherence $c(t)$.

ch:measurement|eq:mp_QL.sheet: IAM measurement criterion: an interaction is irreversible when the heat dissipated in the detector reaches $k_BT_D\ln2$.

ch:measurement|eq:F.sheet: Proposed erasure fidelity of a quantum eraser as a function of dissipated energy; the form carries over the activation ramp.

ch:gravdec|eq:gd_dp.sheet: Di\'osi--Penrose collapse time from the gravitational self-energy of the mass-distribution difference.

ch:gravdec|eq:gd_bitrate.sheet: Postulated rate of information production of a massive superposition.

ch:gravdec|eq:tauIAM.sheet: Integrated decoherence of a massive superposition with boundary capacity $k_BT/E_G$: an exponential with time constant $\tau_{\rm IAM}$.

ch:nonlocal|body:S_{\\max}(t)=2\\sqrt{1+.sheet: Largest CHSH value under pointer-basis dephasing (repeated from Part~\ref{part:qp}).

ch:electroweak|eq:ew:virial.sheet: Time-averaged virial theorem for a potential homogeneous of degree $k$.

ch:electroweak|body:V(r)=-\\frac43\\frac.sheet: Cornell static quark potential, with string tension $\sigma\approx0.18$~GeV$^2$.

ch:koide|eq:ko:Q.sheet: Koide's relation for the charged-lepton pole masses (PDG 2024; $0.66666051$ with the 2022 $m_\tau$).

ch:electronmass|eq:em:result.sheet: The electron-mass fixed point; the factor $(2\pi)^{3/10}$ inside the prefactor $(2\pi)^{-1/10}$ was found by numerical search.

ch:scprimer|body:\\xqp^{\\mathrm{th}}(T).sheet: Thermal-equilibrium quasiparticle density in a BCS superconductor at $T\ll T_c$, normalized per Cooper pair near the gap.

ch:scprimer|eq:catelani.sheet: Qubit relaxation rate from quasiparticle tunneling across the junction (Catelani et al.\ 2011).

ch:xqp|body:x_{\\rmqp}=n_{\\rmqp}/n_{\\r.sheet: Quasiparticle density in the field's normalization; $n_{\rm cp}=2\nu_0\Delta$ counts pairs within $\Delta$ of the Fermi surface. Defines $x_{\rm qp}$.

ch:xqp|eq:xqp.sheet: Steady-state quasiparticle density from $N$ erasure sites, two quasiparticles per event, diffusing over the island volume $V$.

ch:xqp|body:\\frac{x_{\\rmqp}\\,n_{\\rmc.sheet: Same-device test: the dimensionless combination the proposal predicts equals the pair-breaking yield, 2.

ch:ascoreqc|eq:Agate.sheet: Gate error in nats from the two-qubit error probability; equals $p$ to within about $0.5\,\%$ for $p<10^{-2}$ ($\varepsilon/p-1\simeq p/2$).

ch:thermaln|eq:thermal_slope.sheet: Local logarithmic slope of the held-record thermal floor $p_{\rm eq}=1/(1+e^M)$; not a constant (6.85 at 35\,mK, 16.0 at 15\,mK for 5\,GHz).

ch:walls|eq:pdecomp.sheet: Three-part decomposition of a superconducting two-qubit error: coherence, material, control.

ch:walls|eq:t1star.sheet: The coherence optimum of the model $p=a/T_1+b/(T_{1,\mathrm{free}}-T_1)$; its location is set by each device's constants $a$ and $b$.

ch:qplatforms|eq:qp_peq.sheet: Equilibrium occupation of the wrong level of a two-level record with gap $E=hf$ against a bath at $T$: the held-record thermal floor, the left-hand mark of the qubit gauge.

ch:qplatforms|eq:qp_pth.sheet: Thermal floor of one gate of duration $t\ll T_1$: $6.2\times10^{-7}$ for a 5\,GHz transmon at 35\,mK, $T_1=68\,\mu$s, $t=40$\,ns.

ch:qplatforms|eq:qp_rydberg.sheet: Drive optimum of a Rydberg gate: decay falls with the drive, blockade leakage and scattering rise with it.

ch:cmos|body:\\kBT_j\\ln2=3.33\\times10^.sheet: Landauer floor for logic at a junction temperature $T_j=348$\,K.

ch:chipgen|eq:cg_nfloor.sheet: Generations after which a chip reading $R$ times its floor and improving by a constant fraction $s$ per generation would reach the floor: 6.2 at $s=0.646$, 18.5 at $s=1-1/\sqrt2\approx0.293$ for $R=600$.

ch:bridge|eq:landauer.sheet: Landauer's principle: the least heat dissipated in erasing one bit at reservoir temperature $T$.

ch:astrogenetics|body:H(\\beta)=-\\beta\.sheet: Shannon (binary) entropy of a locus with methylated fraction $\beta$, in bits.

ch:landauer|eq:ebit.sheet: Cost of one bit at body temperature, $310.15$\,K.

ch:landauer|eq:M.sheet: The Mahaffey number of the cell: cytosolic ATP drive over $RT$ at body temperature.

ch:landauer|body:M=\\frac{\\Edrive}{\\kB.sheet: The Mahaffey number for any system: drive energy per event over $k_BT$ (no $\ln2$).

ch:landauer|eq:bitsperATP.sheet: Landauer bits one ATP can pay for: $M$ in Landauer units.

ch:landauer|eq:markmargin.sheet: Cellular margin: chemical cost of one methyl mark over the Landauer floor of one bit.

ch:landauer|eq:efloor.sheet: Landauer floor for one rewrite of all 28,217,448 CpGs.

ch:landauer|body:\\frac{\\Delta\\DeltaG}.sheet: Discrimination energy implied by maintenance error rates of 2--10\,\% (equilibrium-discrimination limit).

ch:landauer|eq:phi.sheet: Fraction of one ATP spent per held bit: holding energy over $M$.

ch:surface|eq:H.sheet: Shannon (binary) entropy of a locus with methylated fraction $\beta$, in bits.

ch:surface|eq:jensen.sheet: Jensen's inequality: the entropy of the mean exceeds the mean of the entropies.

ch:surface|eq:meanH.sheet: Mean of the per-site entropies, the statistic of Met-A.

ch:surface|eq:steady.sheet: Steady state of a two-state maintenance chain with loss $u$ and gain $d$ per division.

ch:ledgers|eq:virial.sheet: Virial theorem for a potential homogeneous of degree $k$ (as in Chapter~\ref{ch:virial_law}).

ch:ledgers|eq:smarr.sheet: Smarr relation for a Schwarzschild black hole: rest energy is twice $T_HS$.

ch:floorbreach|eq:Amax.sheet: Far end of the Met-A gauge for neutrophils: every identity site at a coin flip, one bit over the healthy reference.

ch:gauge|eq:A.sheet: The informational fidelity ratio: a reading over the same cell type's healthy reading on the same instrument.

ch:gauge|body:A=\\frac{H(\\text{errornow.sheet: The reading as an error rate: entropy of the error now over the entropy of the error in the same cell when healthy.

ch:meta|eq:meta.sheet: Met-A on arrays, with the frozen EPIC neutrophil reference $0.330263$ bits.

ch:meta|eq:metawb.sheet: Met-A in whole blood: the denominator is the specimen's own composition-matched healthy expectation.

ch:iama|eq:eps.sheet: Copy error on single molecules and the holding energy it implies.

ch:iama|eq:eps0.sheet: The thermal floor of the copy error from a two-state Boltzmann factor, and $H_{\min}=H(\varepsilon_0)$.

ch:cscore|eq:z.sheet: Residual map: each identity site's entropy departure from the healthy reference, in units of the healthy spread $s_i$.

ch:cscore|eq:C.sheet: C-score: variance of $\sqrt{50}\times$ the 50-site block means over the site variance, divided by the healthy median $1.1104$.

ch:temperature|eq:eps0T.sheet: The copy-error floor as a function of body temperature at a fixed holding energy.

ch:separation|eq:mix.sheet: Composition model of Stage~A: measured $\beta$ as a non-negative, sum-to-one mixture of blood-group profiles.

ch:atlas|body:\\begin{aligned}\\beta^{\\.sheet: Atlas v2 hierarchical model: observed $\beta$ per locus, cell and source with a source term $\delta_{is}$; cell means drawn around a shared locus level.

ch:skytools|body:z_i=\\frac{H(\\beta_i)-.sheet: Residual of one array's site entropy from the healthy reference mean, in units of the shrunk healthy spread (as Eq.~\eqref{eq:z}).

ch:sky|eq:sky.sheet: Sky value at identity site $i$: entropy offset from the healthy reference in units of the reference spread.

ch:sky|eq:cellcount.sheet: Cell-count floor: binomial spread of a measured fraction from $N$ diploid genome copies (the counterpart of cosmic variance).

ch:sky|eq:outspan.sheet: The out-of-span map: the residual split into a part any mixture of atlas cells can make and a part none can.

ch:theoryinterp|body:\\frac{S_{\\rminfo}.sheet: Collapse criterion as holographic saturation: record entropy per area reaching $1/4\ell_P^2$ (met exactly at the Schwarzschild radius).

ch:onegauge|body:\\text{Met-A}=\\frac{\\.sheet: Met-A: mean binary entropy over the cell's identity sites over the same quantity on purified healthy cells (same type, same platform).
